title: Cotton, My New Puppy
source_body:
Wednesday, April 16
Today was a special day. My family got a puppy! He is a small white dog with brown ears. We named him Cotton because he looks soft like cotton.
In the morning, Dad and I went to the pet shop. We bought a bed, a bowl, and a red ball for Cotton. At home, Cotton was scared at first. He hid under the sofa for thirty minutes. Then I rolled the red ball to him. He came out and played with me!
At night, Cotton slept in his new bed next to my room. I was so excited. Tomorrow, I will walk him in the park after school.

variants.prestudy:
Wednesday, April 16
Today was one of the most special days of my life, because my family finally adopted a puppy! He is a tiny white dog with floppy brown ears. We decided to name him Cotton, since his fluffy fur looks as soft as a ball of cotton.
Early in the morning, Dad and I visited a pet shop to prepare everything Cotton would need. We picked out a cozy bed, a food bowl, and a bright red ball. When we brought him home, however, Cotton was too frightened to explore his new surroundings. He hid under the sofa and refused to come out for thirty whole minutes. Hoping to make him feel comfortable, I gently rolled the red ball toward him. To my delight, he crept out slowly and began playing with me!
That night, Cotton fell fast asleep in his new bed, which we had placed right next to my room. I was so excited that I could hardly fall asleep myself. Tomorrow, after school, I am planning to take him for his very first walk in the park.
